title: Java: from the first compile to reliable applications
summary: 36 lessons in Java, from first programs and objects to collections, concurrency, testing and practical services. Worked examples and separate solutions connect language rules with observable behavior.

lessons.title: From source file to running JVM
lessons.outcome: Compile and run Main.java with assertions enabled and tell a compiler diagnostic from a runtime failure.
lessons.lab: Start count 1, increment it, then multiply it by 3.

lessons.title: Values, numeric types and conversion
lessons.outcome: Predict integer and decimal arithmetic, widen before overflow, and use BigDecimal value and scale deliberately.
lessons.lab: Add 1 to Integer.MAX_VALUE with Math.addExact.

lessons.title: Decisions, loops and invariants
lessons.outcome: Write guarded conditions, loops with explicit invariants and an exhaustive switch expression, and expose an off-by-one boundary.
lessons.lab: Run the same sum pattern over an empty int array.

lessons.title: Methods and explicit contracts
lessons.outcome: Write methods with explicit preconditions and predict what a call can change for primitive and object arguments.
lessons.lab: Pass int 5 to a helper that reassigns its local parameter to 99.

lessons.title: Arrays, strings and Unicode
lessons.outcome: Copy arrays safely and count, slice and normalize strings by code point instead of by UTF-16 unit.
lessons.lab: Convert lowercase red to uppercase and retain both references.

lessons.title: Lists, sets and maps
lessons.outcome: Choose a List, Set or Map for a counting task and produce deterministic output from unordered collections.
lessons.lab: Insert red twice into a HashSet and inspect return values.

lessons.title: Classes and encapsulation
lessons.outcome: Encapsulate state in a class whose methods reject invalid input and leave the object unchanged on failure.
lessons.lab: Attempt to withdraw 111 from balance 110.

lessons.title: Constructors, records and invariants
lessons.outcome: Write records and constructors that normalize, copy and validate their components so every instance is valid.
lessons.lab: Construct another Order with normalized A and item x.

lessons.title: Exceptions and resource lifetime
lessons.outcome: Manage resources with try-with-resources and read close order, suppressed exceptions and translated causes.
lessons.lab: Throw IllegalStateException in the body and inspect events after catching it.

lessons.title: Interfaces and polymorphism
lessons.outcome: Program to an interface, compose behavior by delegation, and switch exhaustively over a sealed type with record patterns.
lessons.lab: Price 200 cents with NoDiscount, Percent(25) and Fixed(250) through one pattern-matching switch over the sealed Discount interface.

lessons.title: Equality, hashing and ordering
lessons.outcome: Implement consistent equals, hashCode and Comparator ordering and show the failures that inconsistent keys cause.
lessons.lab: Insert two different people of age 20 into a TreeSet comparing age only.

lessons.title: Generics and variance
lessons.outcome: Use generic types and bounded wildcards so producers, consumers and return types stay type-safe.
lessons.lab: Copy List<Integer> into List<Number> with a bounded generic method.

lessons.title: Lambdas and functional interfaces
lessons.outcome: Use lambdas and functional interfaces, compose functions in the intended order, and avoid mutable captured state.
lessons.lab: Compose add 1 and multiply 2 using andThen and compose on 3.

lessons.title: Streams and collectors
lessons.outcome: Build stream pipelines with collectors, explain laziness and single use, and choose a reduction identity that is safe.
lessons.lab: Count red, blue, red with groupingBy and counting.

lessons.title: Dates, time zones and formatting
lessons.outcome: Represent instants, local dates and zoned times correctly across daylight-saving gaps and overlaps.
lessons.lab: Ask for valid offsets at 2024-03-10 02:30 in New York.

lessons.title: Files, paths and character encoding
lessons.outcome: Read and write files with explicit encodings, close directory streams and keep path checks honest.
lessons.lab: Create two files and count them through a try-with-resources Files.list stream.

lessons.title: Optional values and validation boundaries
lessons.outcome: Model optional results with Optional, choose eager or lazy fallbacks, and validate input at the boundary.
lessons.lab: Use a counter-producing fallback with orElse and orElseGet on a present value.

lessons.title: Tests that detect broken behavior
lessons.outcome: Write tests that fail on a broken implementation, including boundary, property and exception checks.
lessons.lab: For values -10 through 10, clamping an already clamped value leaves it unchanged.

lessons.title: Data structures and complexity
lessons.outcome: Choose a queue, stack or priority queue for a task and measure the work a linear search performs.
lessons.lab: Insert 5, 1, 4, 2 and repeatedly poll.

lessons.title: Search, sorting and dynamic programming
lessons.outcome: Implement binary search, stable sorting and dynamic programming that handle empty, tied and unreachable cases.
lessons.lab: Sort records (a, 2), (b, 1) and (c, 2) by key only and inspect the equal-key order.

lessons.title: Threads and the memory model
lessons.outcome: Create threads, publish results safely through start, join or volatile, and respond correctly to interruption.
lessons.lab: Make two workers read counter 0, wait at a barrier, then each write its saved value plus 1.

lessons.title: Executors, futures and cancellation
lessons.outcome: Run tasks with executors and futures that use bounded waits, cooperative cancellation and bounded queues.
lessons.lab: Hold a task on a latch, wait with a short timeout, then release and obtain the result.

lessons.title: Locks, atomics and concurrent collections
lessons.outcome: Protect shared state with locks, atomics and concurrent maps, and avoid deadlock with a single lock order.
lessons.lab: Change 0 to 1 with CAS, then retry expecting 0.

lessons.title: Virtual threads and blocking work
lessons.outcome: Use virtual threads for blocking work, limit scarce resources with a semaphore and cancel blocked tasks.
lessons.lab: Run six tasks but allow only two inside a gated resource section.
lessons.verification: maximum active count 2; all six complete.

lessons.title: JVM memory, GC and allocation
lessons.outcome: Explain object reachability and retention and measure allocation and memory use without misleading claims.
lessons.lab: Create a WeakReference to the still-strongly-referenced array.
lessons.verification: weak get returns the same object while strong reference exists.

lessons.title: Packages, classpaths and modules
lessons.outcome: Compile and run a two-module application and read its module descriptors, exports and dependency errors.
lessons.lab: Create the owned greeting/application fixture and compile both with --module-source-path.
lessons.verification: compiler exit 0 and module-info.class files present.

lessons.title: Builds and dependency reproducibility
lessons.outcome: Build a runnable JAR reproducibly and detect when a changed source produces a different artifact.
lessons.lab: Package the same classes twice with the same timestamp.
lessons.verification: archive byte hashes equal in this prepared JDK.

lessons.title: HTTP services and clients
lessons.outcome: Serve and call an owned loopback HTTP endpoint and keep status, method and route errors distinct.
lessons.lab: POST to /health under a GET-only contract.
lessons.verification: status 405 and method not allowed body.

lessons.title: JDBC and transactions
lessons.outcome: Use JDBC prepared statements and transactions against H2, binding untrusted values and rolling back failures.
lessons.lab: Disable auto-commit, move 20 cents from account 1 to 2, inspect intermediate balances, and rollback.

lessons.title: Serialization and schema evolution
lessons.outcome: Serialize a versioned binary format and reject unknown versions, truncation, oversized lengths and trailing data.
lessons.lab: Change the version bytes to 99 and decode.

lessons.title: Reflection, annotations and service loading
lessons.outcome: Inspect annotations, invoke methods reflectively and load services with ServiceLoader while preserving failure causes.
lessons.lab: Create the temporaryMETA-INF/services entry and discover Greeting providers.
lessons.verification: one Friendly provider with version 2 and working greet.

lessons.title: Profiling and benchmark reasoning
lessons.outcome: Measure performance with warm-up, checksums and JFR events and report the result without overclaiming.
lessons.lab: Time 20 calculations and sum their outputs.

lessons.title: Secure application boundaries
lessons.outcome: Enforce secure file and operation boundaries that reject traversal, symbolic links, oversized input and unknown commands.
lessons.lab: Write five bytes and request a four-byte maximum.

lessons.title: Application design and dependency boundaries
lessons.outcome: Separate pure domain logic from infrastructure so validation and failures are testable before any repository call.
lessons.lab: Request missing and inspect the audit list.

lessons.title: Build a tested local data service
lessons.outcome: Build and test a small local HTTP data service that validates queries strictly and leaves its storage unchanged.
lessons.lab: GET group C, which passes syntax but has no records.

lessons.title: Package, diagnose and maintain a release
lessons.outcome: Package, self-test and verify a release artifact, rejecting tampering before execution and recording its runtime scope.
lessons.lab: Launch the JAR with --self-test through a bounded child JVM.
